title.narrative: Construction of 200 Housing Units with Health, Educational and Basic Infrastructure Facilities for Flood Victims in Kismayo, Federal Republic of Somalia - Mosque Construction

description.narrative: Construction and furnishing of a mosque containing a prayer hall for men and a prayer hall for women, bathrooms for men and women, a room, and an outdoor courtyard.
Contribute to the early recovery of flood-affected families in Somalia by providing permanent shelter and basic services that enhance their stability and improve their quality of life.

Restoring permanent shelter and basic services to contribute to the early recovery of flood-affected families in Somalia, through the construction of 200 economical housing units consisting of two rooms, a kitchen and an external bathroom. The project also includes the construction of basic service facilities including a school, a mosque, a health center, a vertical water tank and a solar power station, in addition to preparing and leveling roads in the targeted area.

Disbursement for "Construction of 200 Housing Units with Health, Educational and Basic Infrastructure Facilities for Flood Victims in Kismayo, Federal Republic of Somalia - Mosque Construction" in Somalia, implemented by Tadamun Social Society
